fields.Name: T213 - Add Record to List
fields.Description: Opens the 'Add to a list' dialog from a record's toolbar and verifies the list-selection UI renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. In the record toolbar (the row of icons at the TOP-LEFT, just above the Details card), click the 'Add to a list' control — the BOOKMARK icon. Verify a dialog/panel opens for adding the record to a List (it shows list options to pick from, or a create-list / select-list UI), with no error. You do NOT need to finish adding — opening the dialog is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Add to a list' (bookmark icon) control in the record toolbar was clicked
A dialog/panel for adding the record to a List opened (list selection or create-list UI)
No error messages or crash pages
